title: The King's Illness
text: Erol was not taken by a brief fever. For months his mind was failing. Mira knew. The court did not.

title: A Request for Mercy
text: On the last night Erol asked not to become the man the illness was making. What Mira did with that request is the argument.

title: Ethan Was in the Room
text: On the night of the accusation, Ethan was inside Mira's chambers. He will not say why. The official story does not survive that fact whole.

title: It Was an Argument
text: The night was about Erol's bastard, not a seduction. Mira says Ethan seized her. Ethan says he stopped her striking him. Both know the sexual charge was not the whole truth.

title: The Maren Payments
text: For twenty-three years an obscure royal account paid House Maren. The payments stopped the month Erol died.

title: Master Ren
text: The old man who taught Arlo history and chess was King Erol. Neither of them said so aloud.

title: A Witness from the Lodge
text: Someone who served at the hunting lodge remembers Lysa, the king's visit, and a pregnancy the household was paid to keep quiet.

title: Erol's Sealed Letter
text: A letter in the king's hand, sealed, delivered to Maren before the death. It does not say 'son'. It refuses to say 'nothing'.

title: The Letter Alistair Kept
text: Every letter from the informant in Caerlyn was burned except one. It proves Alistair knew the king was dying.

title: A Clerk in the Castle
text: Someone inside Caerlyn wrote to Stormhold for months about the king's decline. Alistair destroyed the correspondence. He did not destroy the fact.

title: Harrow's Debts
text: Osric Harrow has been paying bands on the western road to keep them off his villages and on other people's.

title: Edric's Other Letter
text: Mira's nephew has drafted a letter offering House Edevane to whoever looks likely to win. He has not sent it. He has not burned it.

title: Pell's Oath
text: The physician will not describe the dose because Erol forbade him. Silence, in this case, is evidence of a promise.

title: The Last Line
text: Nessa remembers the testament's ending: the crown belongs not to the one born nearest it, but to the one who can keep Nezrel whole.

title: A Paper for Ethan
text: In Erol's own hand, one instruction names his brother. It is authentic. It is not the only one.

title: A Paper about Legitimacy
text: Erol asked, in writing, how a bastard son might be legitimised. He did not finish the act.

title: Emergency Powers
text: Another authentic paper grants Mira extraordinary authority if the king cannot rule. It reads like fear. It can be made to read like a will.

title: Aria's Blood
text: A dangerous rumour with a scrap of paper behind it: Queen Aria may not have been her father's daughter. If true, the great exception was also a lie, or a better argument than anyone wanted.

title: Varos Gold
text: A foreign purse is available to the claimant willing to discuss the lands Erol took twenty years ago.

title: Fragment of the Testament
text: Not the whole missing will. Enough of the hand, and the last sentence, to make every claimant hopeful.

title: Erol's Testament
text: The vanished document. It refuses to name a single heir cleanly. It demands that Nezrel be kept whole, and leaves the method to the living.

title: Celene's Quiet Ships
text: House Veyne has been moving grain off the books. Not treason. Not innocent.

title: Celene's Favour
text: Lady Veyne owes one political act. She will pay it once, exactly, and then the ledger is clean.

call.text: Veyne ships move because Celene said they should.

title: Tomas Maren's Favour
text: The lord who raised Arlo will spend himself once for you, and hate the spending.

title: The Keeper's Favour
text: Father Aldren will speak a blessing he can still square with his conscience. Once.

title: Osric and the Road
text: Harrow did not hire the raiders to burn the west. He paid them to burn someone else's west. The distinction will not survive daylight.

title: The Guard Is Split
text: Soldiers say Garran still stands up when Ethan's name is used. They say it softly.

title: Talk of a Will
text: Taverns have already decided what Erol's missing testament says. They do not agree with each other.
